purpose: Forbid opening a combined portfolio sample until two independently validated alpha families exist, then require a separately preregistered twelve-month locked-forward portfolio study.

activation_requirements.sleeve_evidence_contract: Each candidate must carry an append-only result portfolio_activation_evidence object with sample_role=locked_forward, pre_registered=true, parameter_changes_after_start=0, and locked_validation_status=PASS.
activation_requirements.portfolio_sample_starts_at: first UTC midnight strictly after the portfolio manifest and sleeve source receipts are sealed
activation_requirements.portfolio_must_use: the separately enforced portfolio-promotion policy for source-replayed accounting, execution, risk, and selection-bias evidence

prohibited: constructing a portfolio from registry status alone
using same-family parameter variants to satisfy the two-sleeve requirement
backdating the portfolio manifest to include earlier sleeve returns
treating a portfolio preregistration as approval for live or test orders
